name: InternalErrors_'s Insurable Items
teaser: Grenades, ammo, knives and meds are completely insurable!
description_html:
THIS MOD IS SIMPLY AN UPDATE OF INTERNALERROR_’S MODS, COMBINED. ALL CREDIT FOR CODE GOES TO HIM. THANK YOU ERROR!

Meds, ammo, knives and grenades can be configured to be insurable or not.

All of these items are enabled by default.

Installation

Simply drop the InternalError-InsurableItems into user/mods/

Visit the config folder, and open the config.json to choose what you want to become insurable or not.

Compatibility

If any mod changes insurability of the above items, IT WILL CONFLICT!

Simply change the mod folder name to:

zInternalError-InsurableItems-1.0.0 Doing so will load this mod first.
